newsitem.title: GREECE: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) RAISES GASOLINE PRICES.
newsitem.headline: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) RAISES GASOLINE PRICES.

text.p: Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) will raise gasoline prices by 1.30 drachmas per litre, effective on Thursday.
Heating fuel prices will be raised by 1.40 drachmas and transport diesel by 1.0 drachmas per litre, it said.

The price adjustments come after higher world gasoline and diesel prices, up by $2.2 and $2.7 per metric tonne and a firmer dollar/drachma exchange rate, up 3.90 drachmas per $, DEP said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
